title: Alarm fires exactly once and doAlarmFired records objectName and scheduledTime
asA: developer whose SingleCellObject schedules future work via storage.setAlarm
iWant: the alarm() handler to fire exactly once per scheduled time and doAlarmFired to carry object name and scheduled time
soThat: the applied project can observe alarm delivery through the metadata-only sink and trust the once-per-schedule contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: A SingleCellObject with setAlarm(offsetMs=100) fires alarm() when driven at the scheduled time. The alarm() handler runs exactly once, deletes the persisted alarm from storage (getAlarm() returns null after the fire) and emits a doAlarmFired event on the injected sink with {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp, objectName, scheduledTime} where objectName is the object's name and scheduledTime matches the setAlarm scheduled millis. A second call to alarm() on the drained storage does NOT emit a second doAlarmFired for the same schedule (the storage.getAlarm() returns null so the second fire records scheduledTime null).
acceptanceCriteria.when: alarm() is driven once and then again after the fire
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first fire emits doAlarmFired with the scheduledTime; the second fire records scheduledTime null; storage.getAlarm() returns null after the first fire
